cd /tmp/dev && cat > t2.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/dev')
from harness import *

ok = True
L = lease('home', '2001:db8:1:1200::/56', 0, 100, (0,), 2)
S = {'web': 'tcp'}
T1 = '2001:db8:1:1200::1'
T2 = '2001:db8:1:1200::2'

def ledger_of(rows, queries=(10,)):
    got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, list(queries), [make_capture(rows)]))
    return got

# revision conflict at the same revision -> conflict
rows = [icmp('a', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo'),
        icmp('b', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo')]
ok &= check('same revision different content', ledger_of(rows)['snapshots'][0]['ledger'],
            {'live': 0, 'deleted': 0, 'conflict': 1})

# identical semantic content (spelling/decimal/base64 differences) collapse
rows = [icmp('a', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i1', '2001:DB8:1:1200:0:0:0:1', '2001:0db8:1:1200::1', 'echo'),
        icmp('b', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo')]
ok &= check('collapse identical', ledger_of(rows)['snapshots'][0]['ledger'],
            {'live': 1, 'deleted': 0, 'conflict': 0})

# lower revision never repairs
rows = [icmp('a', 1, 5, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo'),
        icmp('b', 0, 6, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo')]
ok &= check('lower revision ignored', ledger_of(rows)['snapshots'][0]['ledger'],
            {'live': 1, 'deleted': 0, 'conflict': 0})

# two distinct contents at top revision -> conflict
rows = [icmp('a', 2, 5, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo'),
        icmp('b', 2, 6, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'error'),
        icmp('c', 1, 7, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo')]
ok &= check('top revision conflict', ledger_of(rows)['snapshots'][0]['ledger'],
            {'live': 0, 'deleted': 0, 'conflict': 1})

# tombstone then resurrection
rows = [icmp('a', 0, 5, 'delete'),
        icmp('b', 1, 6, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo')]
ok &= check('resurrect', ledger_of(rows)['snapshots'][0]['ledger'],
            {'live': 1, 'deleted': 0, 'conflict': 0})
ok &= check('resurrect internal', ledger_of(rows)['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['internal'], [T1])

# tombstone at max revision with equal put -> conflict
rows = [icmp('a', 1, 5, 'delete'),
        icmp('b', 1, 6, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo')]
ok &= check('delete vs put same revision', ledger_of(rows)['snapshots'][0]['ledger'],
            {'live': 0, 'deleted': 0, 'conflict': 1})

# delete with non-empty trailing field -> rejected record
rows = [icmp('a', 0, 5, 'delete', 'home')]
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(rows)]))
ok &= check('delete junk rejected', got['rejected'], [[0, 0]])
ok &= check('delete junk ledger', got['snapshots'][0]['ledger'], {'live': 0, 'deleted': 0, 'conflict': 0})

# visibility by published across queries
rows = [icmp('a', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo'),
        icmp('b', 0, 50, 'put', 'home', 2, '0/i2', T2, T2, 'echo')]
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10, 60], [make_capture(rows)]))
ok &= check('visibility q10', got['snapshots'][0]['ledger'], {'live': 1, 'deleted': 0, 'conflict': 0})
ok &= check('visibility q60', got['snapshots'][1]['ledger'], {'live': 2, 'deleted': 0, 'conflict': 0})
ok &= check('visibility q60 internal', got['snapshots'][1]['leases'][0]['internal'], [T1, T2])

# app and icmp identities share the id space but differ by type
rows = [icmp('x', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo'),
        app('x', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 1, T1, 'open', 'web', 0, '')]
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(rows)]))
ok &= check('type separates identities', got['snapshots'][0]['ledger'],
            {'live': 2, 'deleted': 0, 'conflict': 0})

# rejected indices across captures and ordinals
c0 = make_capture([icmp('bad', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 1, '9/i1', T1, T1, 'echo'),
                   icmp('ok', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo')])
c1 = make_capture([icmp('ok2', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 2, '0/i2', T2, T2, 'echo'),
                   ['app', 'nope', '0', '5', 'put', 'home', '2', '', T2, '', 'open', 'nosvc', '0', ''],
                   icmp('ok3', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 2, '0/i2', T2, T2, 'echo')])
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [c0, c1]))
ok &= check('rejected indices', got['rejected'], [[0, 0], [1, 1]])
ok &= check('rejected ledger', got['snapshots'][0]['ledger'], {'live': 3, 'deleted': 0, 'conflict': 0})

print('ALL OK' if ok else 'FAILURES')
PYEOF
